migration: 1.0.0 to 1.1.0: anchors made game-agnostic (constants live in the game profile), lens gates added; ids, weights and passAt unchanged; 1.1.0 to 1.1.1: gameProfile generalized to your-game-profile for the public kit and hash recomputed with the documented kit algorithm (spec/RUBRIC_HASH.md); ids, weights, anchors and passAt unchanged. 1.1.1 to 1.1.3: Evidence descriptions and fixture working directories now refer to the distributed kit. 1.1.3 to 1.1.4: Empty samples and zero case counts earn U. Computed lines require the declared evidence type. 1.1.4 to 1.1.5: Requires supported-device runs, traced ready events and comparable simulation replays. 1.1.5 to 1.2.0: Line, pillar and anchor wording made genre-neutral (ids, weights, conditions and pass marks unchanged); adds owner-selected not-applicable profiles no-aiming, no-hazards, offline-only. 1.2.0 to 1.3.0: Evidence pack names made genre-neutral (heldFireMaxDeltaPct to heldInputMaxDeltaPct; heldFire to heldInput; onlineMatchesPractice to onlineMatchesOffline; damagingThreatsOffscreen to hazardsOffscreen; edgeThreatVisibleRatio to edgeHazardVisibleRatio; edgeThreatVisibleMin to edgeHazardVisibleMin; aimErrorP95Deg to targetingErrorP95Deg; aim to targeting). Scoring, weights, conditions and pass marks unchanged; rename these fields in packs made for 1.2.0.
levels: Levels 0 to 4, or U. U earns zero points and excludes the line weight from measured coverage. Record skipped execution as NOT_RUN.

verdict: PASS, CONDITIONAL or BLOCKED is reported separately from the grade and coverage. An unresolved P0 blocks.
source: Input traces, matched feedback captures and simulation replays from the build under review.
samplePolicy: Each computed metric group needs a nonempty population. Use the listed sample arrays or positive integer case counts. For other groups supply a positive integer measuredCases from the capture. Empty inputs or zero measured cases earn U and zero points. A measured zero failures is valid.

no-aiming.reason: The game has no aimed, selected or steered input to compare with intent. Select only after the owner approves it, before scoring.

no-hazards.reason: Nothing in the game can hurt the player or make them fail from off screen. Select only after the owner approves it, before scoring.

offline-only.reason: The game has no online or predicted simulation path to compare. Select only after the owner approves it, before scoring.
